name: load_minilang_frontend
summary: Report frontend availability; the self-host build links it statically.

name: normalize_code_for_tokenizer
summary: Normalize comments/newlines while preserving source offsets for diagnostics. Operate on one capacity-backed UTF-8 byte buffer: the previous character- string builder allocated one managed string and one array slot per source byte, which dominated frontend memory on large self-hosted compilations.

name: parse_program
summary: Load and parse one file, returning syntax failures in the result record.

name: parse_program_keepgoing
summary: Parse one file while collecting up to max_errors syntax diagnostics.

name: _new_function_node
summary: Keep compiler-internal closure fields centralized when surface syntax creates ordinary, lambda, iterator or async functions.

name: stack_variadic
summary: Internal-only marker: a proven non-escaping variadic tail may live in the caller's rooted expression stack instead of allocating a heap array.

name: Coalesce
summary: Lazy void coalescing (`left ?? right`).

name: CompileFrame
summary: Mutable state for one nested #if/#elif/#else group.

name: CompileValue
summary: One typed value available while evaluating conditional-compilation directives.

name: DeferredCapture
summary: Compiler-internal expression used while emitting deferred calls.

name: Import
summary: Statement/declaration AST shared by analysis and code generation.

name: InterfaceDef
summary: Compile-time structural contract with no runtime representation.

name: Lambda
summary: Parser-only anonymous function lowered to an ordinary nested closure.

name: LazyIteratorState
summary: Mutable construction state for a lazy iterator's pull-closure state machine. Integer state IDs keep suspension/resumption explicit and avoid materializing yielded elements in an intermediate array.

name: Num
summary: Expression AST. Every node carries source coordinates for later diagnostics.

name: ParameterList
summary: Compact parser results for rich parameter and call-argument lists.

name: ParseError
summary: Parser failure with absolute source offset and originating filename.

name: ParserChunkTail
summary: Capacity-backed parser list tail used to avoid repeated array concatenation.

name: ParserChunkVoidSentinel
summary: Internal marker that distinguishes spare capacity from a real void element.

name: preprocess_compile_directives
summary: Evaluate line-oriented directives and retain every original byte offset.

name: SafeMember
summary: Void-safe member access (`value?.member`).

name: set_compile_defines
summary: Install command-line/project values. Later -D occurrences override earlier ones.

name: set_compile_target
summary: Select immutable values for subsequent source parses.

name: TK_NL
summary: Compact discriminants stored in the token arena's byte kind column.

name: Token
summary: Lexical token preserving raw value and absolute source offset.

name: TokenArena
summary: Structure-of-arrays token arena. Parser cursors are integer IDs; kinds use one byte and positions/text IDs use packed u32 columns. Identifier, keyword and operator spellings are module-local symbols instead of per-token strings.

name: TypeGuard
summary: Runtime guard inserted at explicitly annotated type boundaries.

name: _copy_native_bytes
summary: Copy immutable string payloads directly into paged byte buffers. MiniLang's collector is non-moving, so both managed objects remain stable for the duration of this synchronous native copy.

name: align_up
summary: Round n upward to the next power-of-two alignment boundary.

name: arr_chunk_new
summary: Create a chunked array builder with the requested tail capacity.

name: arr_chunked_groups
summary: Return the storage groups of a chunked sequence without flattening their elements. Hot consumers can traverse the small outer array and each fixed chunk directly, avoiding an indexed lookup and shape validation per value.

name: arr_drop_last
summary: Return every array element except the last one. The builtin slice() operates on bytes, so compiler data structures must use an explicit array copy.

name: arr_merge_chunk_groups_with_tail
summary: Flatten existing chunk groups plus the active tail directly into the final array. This avoids allocating and copying a temporary outer `groups + tail` array at every builder finalization.

name: arr_merge_variadic_parts
summary: Merge short-lived call-site parts without first allocating an outer array. The variadic tail is read-only and never escapes, so the compiler represents it as an immutable view over the caller's argument slots.

name: arr_vec_clear
summary: Reset a compiler-internal vector without discarding its capacity. Stale backing slots are intentionally left in place: compiler worklists normally reference the still-live AST, and overwriting the active prefix on the next pass is cheaper than clearing the complete high-water capacity.

name: arr_vec_count_trusted
summary: Trusted variants are used only after one nominal ArrayVector check. They retain logical bounds handling but omit redundant shape validation.

name: arr_vec_is
summary: ArrayVector is compiler-internal and always created by arr_vec_new. A nominal test avoids repeated guarded member probes on hot accesses while still rejecting unrelated structs deterministically.

name: arr_vec_release_refs
summary: Reset a transient vector and remove every managed reference from its backing store.  Ordinary arr_vec_clear deliberately retains stale slots for speed; compiler phase arenas must use this stronger form before a collection so a high-water worklist cannot keep already emitted AST nodes alive.

name: ArrayChunkBuilder
summary: Append-only array builder that avoids copying a growing prefix.

name: ArrayChunkTail
summary: Partially filled final chunk with explicit logical length.

name: ArrayChunkVoidSentinel
summary: Internal marker that preserves actual void values inside spare capacity.

name: ArrayVector
summary: Capacity-backed mutable sequence for compiler-internal hot paths.  MiniLang arrays have exact length, so repeatedly doing `items = items + [value]` copies the complete prefix.  ArrayVector grows geometrically and is materialized only at API boundaries.

name: ast_arena_release
summary: Drop every compilation-owned compact AST column and intern table. This is a bulk ownership boundary: callers must release only after code generation no longer holds or dereferences NodeIds from this arena.

name: ast_bin_new
summary: Binary expressions are the most frequent composite AST node. Store their children and metadata in a typed structure-of-arrays arena while retaining the same accessors for compiler-created legacy structs.

name: AST_LEAF_NUM
summary: Compact arena for immutable expression leaves. Negative integers are stable NodeIds; ordinary non-negative MiniLang values therefore never collide with compiler AST handles. The structure-of-arrays layout keeps source locations, variable symbols and kinds out of individual managed structs.

name: byte_pages_append_string
summary: Append a string's UTF-8 payload without first allocating an equally large temporary bytes value. String length is stored in bytes by the runtime, and the payload immediately follows the common eight-byte object header.

name: byte_pages_append_u16
summary: Append one little-endian 16-bit value without a temporary bytes object.

name: byte_pages_append_u32
summary: Append one little-endian 32-bit value without allocating a temporary four-byte object. Object serialization writes several integers per label and relocation, so avoiding that allocation materially reduces allocator and GC traffic on large programs.

name: byte_pages_append_u64
summary: Append one little-endian 64-bit value. MiniLang integers carry 61 payload bits; the writer deliberately preserves their sign-extended bit pattern.

name: byte_pages_new
summary: Create an empty paged byte buffer.

name: byte_pages_page_count
summary: Expose read-only pages to streaming serializers. The final page may contain spare capacity; byte_pages_page_used() reports the exact writable prefix.

name: BytePages
summary: Paged byte buffer used by large assembler and linker outputs.

name: extern_library_label_token
summary: Encode the exact UTF-8 library spelling into a reversible assembler-label token. Paths and punctuation must not collapse to one dynamic-import slot.

name: FastMap
summary: Compiler-internal open-addressing map with power-of-two capacity.

name: fastmap_new
summary: FastMap operations use deterministic hashing and linear probing.

name: fastmap_release_refs
summary: Reset a transient map including stale generations.  Epoch-only clearing is O(1), but its old key/value cells remain visible to the tracing collector. Batch arenas call this at ownership boundaries, trading one linear sweep for prompt reclamation of large analysis graphs.

name: fastmap_track_refs
summary: Enable precise reference release only for phase-local maps. Production symbol and label indexes retain the O(1) insertion path and do not pay for a touched-slot side vector they never need to reset strongly.
